title: Coconut Key Lime Yogurt Muffins
changes_from_base: A Greek yoghurt batter sharpened with Key lime zest and juice, topped with coconut flakes and a lime icing drizzle.
summary: Tangy yoghurt muffins with Key lime zest and juice, coconut flakes and a lime glaze.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
Key limes (or 2 ordinary limes), zest of all and 2 tbsp juice
sweetened coconut flakes or desiccated coconut

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin. Whisk the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a bowl.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: Beat the melted butter and sugar with a hand mixer until combined, then beat in the yoghurt, eggs, lime zest and the 2 tbsp lime juice.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir in the dry mix with a wooden spoon just until no flour shows.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Fill the cases two-thirds full, sprinkle the coconut over and bake about 20 min, until a cocktail stick comes out clean.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Cool 5 min in the tin, then on the rack. Stir the icing sugar with the 2 tsp lime juice and drizzle over the cold muffins.

tips: The most common mistake is zesting too deep; take only the green skin, as the white pith is bitter.
Ordinary limes are fine; use 2 for the same zest and juice.
Full-fat Greek yoghurt gives the most tender crumb.
storage: Keep in an airtight box for up to 2 days, or freeze unglazed for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
